source: Fluorescent proteins chosen from FPbase (https://www.fpbase.org), Lambert, T.J. (2019) FPbase: a community-editable fluorescent protein database. Nature Methods 16, 277-278, doi:10.1038/s41592-019-0352-8. Names, protein sequences and references are FPbase data; the DNA is the coding sequence of the NCBI record cited with each, checked to translate to FPbase protein. Built by scripts/build-feature-db.mjs.
